answer: Require each agent identity to anchor to one verifiable business registration, checked against the official registry and re-verified every quarter. One registration equals one identity; a mismatch suspends earnings at once. Picture an island registry: each agent is a sparrow nesting in exactly one registered harbour, its jade seal — the registry record — public for anyone to inspect. A sybil then needs a real company per fake, about $300 in filing fees plus annual tax filings, so 1,000 fakes cost over $300,000.
